actions.description: Durably fence the old primary and atomically promote the replica
actions.command:
python - <<'PY'
import os
import socket
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

state = Path('/var/lib/failover')
failed = state / 'primary.failed'
fenced = state / 'primary.fenced'
role = state / 'replica.role'
upstream = state / 'upstream'

if not failed.exists():
    raise SystemExit('refusing promotion: primary.failed is missing')

# Confirm the failed-primary endpoint is not occupied before fencing.
with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as probe:
    probe.settimeout(0.2)
    if probe.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1', 8081)) == 0:
        raise SystemExit('refusing promotion: old primary port 8081 is still listening')

# Persist the fence first and make both the file and direc…

actions.description: Verify the public API, preserved records, promotion, and UTF-8 write
actions.command:
set -u
check() {
  expected_status="$1"; expected_body="$2"; url="$3"
  out=$(mktemp)
  status=$(curl --max-time 5 -sS -o "$out" -w '%{http_code}' "$url")
  body=$(python -c 'import sys;print(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read().decode(),end="")' "$out")
  rm -f "$out"
  printf '%s status=%s body=%q\n' "$url" "$status" "$body"
  test "$status" = "$expected_status" && test "$body" = "$expected_body"
}
